turns.prompt: cd_lysozyme.txt is a Jasco CD export (German locale). The sample is lysozyme, 14.3 kDa, 129 residues, at 0.2 mg/mL in a 0.1 cm cell. Report the CD signal in mdeg at 222 nm and 208 nm (cd_222, cd_208), the mean residue ellipticity at 222 nm in deg·cm²·dmol⁻¹ (mre_222), and the shortest wavelength at which the HT voltage is still at or below 600 V (min_wavelength_ht600), below which data should not be trusted.

provenance: mimic of a Jasco Spectra Manager text export, s2.jasco
